subject: Acme Health — SOC 2 / Audit log & retention follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 18:15:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Health — SOC 2 / Audit log & retention follow-up

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and the concrete next steps so we can keep momentum with procurement/security: 

Summary of pain points / goals we heard from Acme Health
- Need vendor SOC 2 Type II report and pen-test summary as part of procurement checklist
- Requirement for tamper-evident audit logs and the ability to export logs for 3–7 years (you mentioned 5 years preferred)
- Data residency + retention policy alignment (HIPAA-adjacent workloads)
- DPA and security evidence to be shared with legal for sign-off

What Redwood can provide (covered on the call):
- SOC 2 Type II scope and most recent report (redacted) — see attached SOC2_summary.pdf
- Audit logging: detailed event types, retention configuration (defaults and custom), and export instructions (see attached audit-logs-export-instructions.txt). Our logs include who/what/when for inference requests and control-plane events, with immutable append-only storage for configured retention windows.
- Data retention & deletion: customers can configure per-tenant retention; we offer standard retention tiers (30d, 1y, 3y, 5y) and can support contractual controls for longer retention when required.
- DPA: I’ve attached our standard DPA executed copy for Acme (DPA_redwood_acme_signed.pdf).
- Pen test evidence: we can share the executive summary and remediation log; we do not publish raw PII in reports but can provide redacted evidence and an on-demand reviewer call with our security lead.

Open questions / items you asked us to confirm
- Exact retention window Acme requires (you indicated 5 years; can you confirm?)
- Will your legal/procurement accept a redacted SOC 2 report or do you need an unredacted copy under NDA?
- Which team should we send the pen-test executive summary to (legal or InfoSec primary contact)?

Proposed next steps
1) I will drop the attachments + a link to the SOC2 folder in Drive (below) — ACTION: Marissa (today)
2) Lisa to confirm retention window and whether Acme requires an unredacted SOC2 under NDA — ACTION: Lisa (by 2026-02-13)
3) If you want, set a short follow-up call with Vivek (solutions engineer) to walk the audit-log export and retention UI — ACTION: Marissa/Vivek (week of 2/16)
4) Legal review of DPA and confirm signature path — ACTION: Acme legal (TBD)

Attachments:
- SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 520KB)
- audit-logs-export-instructions.txt (TXT, 3KB)
- DPA_redwood_acme_signed.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeSOC2
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/ACME-67890

If that all looks right I’ll schedule the 30-min technical follow-up with Vivek to demo the audit-export workflow. Thanks — appreciate the clear list of compliance requirements this morning.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (555) 213-4490
[Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf]

From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt O'Neil <matt.oneil@acmehealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health — SOC 2 / Audit log & retention follow-up

Thanks Marissa — this is great and exactly what procurement/security needs for next steps. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: Acme's minimum is 5 years for audit logs for this class of data. Can you confirm Redwood can commit to preserving logs for 5 years in an immutable store?
- SOC 2: We can accept a redacted Type II under our standard NDA, but InfoSec will likely request an unredacted copy under a more restrictive NDA. Is Redwood open to an NDA that allows us to review the full report with specific redactions?
- Pen test: please send the executive summary + remediation status to security@acmehealth.com (cc'd is Matt O'Neil who owns procurement). If you can also include a short note on how pen-test findings map to our control families (logging/alerting, network controls), that would speed review.

We'd like to get legal/procurement to sign off next week if possible — I'll confirm timelines internally and get back to you by EOD Friday. Please schedule the technical follow-up with Vivek; a demo of the export process would be helpful.

Thanks,

Lisa
Lisa Tran
Director, Information Security | Acme Health
lisa.tran@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0112

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@acmehealth.com>, Matt O'Neil <matt.oneil@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health — SOC 2 / Audit log & retention follow-up

Thanks Lisa — appreciate the quick reply and the clear ask. Short answers below and next steps.

- Retention: Yes — Redwood supports a contractual 5-year immutable retention window for audit logs. We store audit events in an append-only store backed by WORM-style snapshots; exportable on request. We will provide a short technical note for your InfoSec team describing the immutability controls.

- SOC 2: We can provide a redacted Type II report under standard NDA today. For an unredacted review we are happy to sign a review-specific NDA that limits distribution and requires return/destruction of materials — we've done this with other healthcare customers. I'll have legal (Neha) coordinate the NDA templates.

- Pen test summary: Attached is the executive summary and a mapping doc that calls out which findings map to logging/alerting and network controls (short doc included in the SOC2 folder). We'll send the pen-test executive summary to security@acmehealth.com now.

Immediate next steps I will take today:
- Send the pen-test executive summary to security@acmehealth.com and Matt (attached) — ACTION: Marissa (done)
- Put together the immutability/retention technical note for your InfoSec team — ACTION: Vivek & Marissa (delivery 2026-02-13)
- Neha (legal) will reach out with our review NDA for an unredacted SOC2 — ACTION: Neha (today)

Propose follow-up: 30-min technical demo on Mon 2026-02-16 at 10:00 AM PT to walk audit log export and retention config. Does that work for your team?

Attachments: pen-test-exec-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
Drive folder (same): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeSOC2

If that schedule works I’ll send a calendar invite and include Vivek for the demo. Looking forward to moving this through procurement — thanks again.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (555) 213-4490
[Attachment: pen-test-exec-summary.pdf]
